disposition_reason: Gallium was not detected in any of 61 Romanian honey samples. The printed limit of quantification is 0.04 µ/L in solution while the results column is labeled µg/kg, so no honey concentration in µg/kg is stated. Other elements in the same paper are not extracted in this gallium record.
disposition_locator: Results; Table 2 note (LoQ for 70 Ga 0.04 µ/L; gallium unit µg/kg); Methods 2.1

study.method: ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP Q) after microwave digestion of about 0.5 g honey in aqua regia (9 mL HCl and 3 mL HNO3), Milestone START D
lod: LoQ for gallium printed as 0.04 µ/L (Table 2 note). The same note says the gallium unit of measure is µg/kg. No dilution factor is given.
study.qa: Digestion in triplicate is described for honey. A gallium certified reference material is not reported in the gallium note.

material.form: as collected from the production lot

findings.group: 61 honey samples from Romania, 2018 and 2021, all floral types pooled by the authors' non-detect statement
findings.reported: not detected; LoQ printed as 0.04 µ/L; table unit for gallium stated as µg/kg
findings.notes: Do not treat the non-detect as zero and do not treat 0.04 µ/L as 0.04 µg/kg. The paper's sample accounting is internally inconsistent (61 samples versus labels H1 to H33; multifloral n of 11 versus 15). The non-detect statement is what the gallium column supports.

unresolved: Solution LoQ in µ/L is not converted by the paper to a honey concentration in µg/kg.
non_numeric_findings: Gallium is grouped with elements the authors say were undetectable in all honey samples (Results).
